question: Why is Gluttony using a knife, when he can just eat?
answer: Well ya know, when you line up all sorts of delicious-looking beef and pork in front of someone who loves to eat, and tell them “Eat up!”, they’ll happily eat it, but if you ask if they’d cheerfully eat monkey brains or fried bugs or even physiologically impossible things, it’s probably physiologically impossible. “Gluttony” also holds the meaning of not eating what you don’t want to eat.
